meta.title: Rihla — Thirty Years, One Line
meta.description: Retracing Ibn Battuta's thirty-year journey in one line.

tangier.name: Tangier
tangier.line: Aged twenty-one, he leaves his birthplace for the pilgrimage to Mecca.

mecca.name: Mecca
mecca.line: Meant to be the destination, it becomes the beginning.

samarkand.name: Samarkand
samarkand.line: He describes it as one of the finest and most beautiful cities.

delhi.name: Delhi
delhi.line: He records serving as a judge at the court of Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq.

maldives.name: Maldives
maldives.line: By his account, he serves as a judge once more, this time on the islands.

quanzhou.name: Quanzhou (Zaitun)
quanzhou.line: He writes of its harbour as one of the largest in the world.

timbuktu.name: Timbuktu
timbuktu.line: Across the Sahara, first to the capital of Mali, then on to the Niger.

fez.name: Fez
fez.line: His travels over, he dictates the Rihla.
